If you are in doubt about whether you are registered, check the Voter Information Portal at www.sdsos.gov (Opens in new window) or call the county auditor at 605-387-4212. Registration may be completed during regular business hours at the county auditor's office, municipal finance office, secretary of state's office, and those locations that provide driver's licenses, SNAP, TANF, WIC, military recruitment, and assistance to the disabled as provided by the Department of Human Services. You may contact the county auditor to request a mail-in registration form or access a mail-in form at www.sdsos.gov (Opens in new window) or the Hutchinson County website at www.hutchinsoncountysd.org . Any voter who needs assistance, pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, may contact the county auditor for information and special assistance in voter registration. Diane Hoffman Hutchinson County Auditor It's Property Tax Season! The Hutchinson County Treasurer's Office would like to remind taxpayers that the second half of the 2026 property taxes and mobile home taxes are due on or before Saturday October 31, 2026. Payment must be received or postmarked by October 31, 2026 to avoid interest charges. Interest will begin accruing on November 1, 2026 on any unpaid balance that has not been paid or postmarked. Please note: If you payment is mailed after the deadline, please contact the Hutchinson County Treasurer's Office at 605-387-4213 for the correct amount including any applicable interest. We encourage taxpayers to plan ahead and submit payments before the deadline to avoid additional charges. You can pay online at https://pay-hutchinsoncountysd.com or by calling 605-857-4765.
